questions.text: Mandatory : No Calculator : None Response Time : N.A Think Time : N.A Minimum Instruction Time : 0 Four candidates are being considered for a Software Engineer position. Candidate D > Candidate A > Candidate C > Candidate B
Candidate C > Candidate D > Candidate A or Candidate B
